headline: Accepted a generative artificial intelligence policy, EHAG, and approved a $1,000 deputy treasurer stipend; accepted a $21,134,643.90 manifest.
summary: Members heard student updates, a capital improvement plan listing projects at six schools, and discussion of HB 1300, a bill described as a spending cap. Decisions were limited to the consent agenda, a deputy treasurer appointment, and a policy on generative artificial intelligence.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including the $21,134,643.90 manifest, the Arielle Welch staff nomination, and the Amanda Bonifacio staff resignation, 7-0.
Approved the appointment of Christina Kaskiewicz as deputy treasurer, with a term through June 30, 2029, and a $1,000 annual stipend, 7-0.
Accepted policy EHAG, Generative Artificial Intelligence, on second reading, 7-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Jenna Paradise Moved to accept the Consent Agenda, Staff nomination of Arielle Welch, and Staff resignation of Amanda Bonifacio. Jamie Carreau seconded the Motion. Vote: Unanimous 7/0

Jenna Paradise Moved to accept the appointment of Christina Kaskiewicz to the position of Deputy Treasurer and to set up a term to run through June 30th, 2029, and to set the annual stipend at $1,000. David Clapp seconded the Motion. Vote: Unanimous 7/0
Jenna Paradise Moved to accept policy EHAG as presented. Karen Rand seconded the Motion. Vote: Unanimous (7/0)
